title: Parlay fills: 3 in 8 minutes (09:24-09:31 UTC)
body: The maker won, confirmed and filled 3 parlays this job after the margin cut and the cash-reserve change: ATP games spread + total (price 0.465, fair 0.463, $0.95 stake), NBA Over 219.5 + Over 234.5 (0.254 vs fair 0.253, $9.30 stake, $27.31 collateral), NBA Over 222.5 + Under 217.5 (0.265 vs 0.264, $9.31, $25.82). All two-leg game-line parlays at about 0.25-0.5 win chance, priced at roughly our fair (edge about +0.1 pt each, so the profit depends on our fair being right). Another filled at 07:36 UTC. Free cash is now about $65 with 5 parlays open. Nothing too easy to win: every leg is at most 0.73.
